source_name: VÚB banka – Nákup a obstarávanie (procurement / supplier page)
why_relevant: The only confirmed Slovak-language procurement page of a systemic SK bank found in this cell. States that VÚB normally runs 'obstarávacie súťaže' (procurement competitions) with more than one potential partner, and describes supplier lifecycle rules, evaluation and market monitoring for new suppliers. Entry point for VÚB (Intesa Sanpaolo group) sourcing rules and, potentially, RFP contact channels.

source_name: Intesa Sanpaolo Portale Fornitori (group e-sourcing portal covering VÚB)
why_relevant: Intesa Sanpaolo runs a single group supplier portal with online self-registration, tender (gara) participation, communications and order/invoice areas. Since VÚB is an Intesa subsidiary, group-level sourcing events touching Slovakia are most likely executed here rather than in any SK-national system. Self-registration manuals are public PDFs and disclose the process, categories and country handling.

source_name: Erste Group Procurement (EGP) – group procurement entity page (covers Slovenská sporiteľňa)
source_subtype: group procurement entity / vendor onboarding page
why_relevant: Slovenská sporiteľňa is the largest SK bank and an Erste subsidiary; its sourcing above tactical thresholds is centralised in Erste Group Procurement (formerly s ProServ / Procurement Services GesmbH), which runs group-wide Sourcing vs Tactical Purchasing tracks and a standardised supplier onboarding based on the Supplier Code of Conduct. This is the structural key to who actually decides SLSP vendor selection.

source_name: KBC Group – Our suppliers / supplier sustainability & procurement policy (covers ČSOB SK)
why_relevant: ČSOB Slovensko sits under KBC; KBC publishes group supplier expectations and a Sustainability Code of Conduct for Suppliers that binds local subsidiaries' vendor onboarding. Best available group-level statement of ČSOB SK vendor requirements in the absence of a public SK supplier page.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa – site search endpoint for supplier/procurement terms
why_relevant: No dedicated public 'pre dodávateľov' page for SLSP surfaced in search; the bank's own site search is the practical crawl entry point for any supplier code, procurement notice or vendor-onboarding document published under slsp.sk (including /content/dam/ PDF paths, which are indexable).

source_name: uvostat.sk – supplier profile: Slovenská sporiteľňa, a.s.
why_relevant: Private SK banks are not contracting authorities, but they appear in ÚVO data as SUPPLIERS to the public sector. The supplier-side profile reveals which public bodies buy banking/payment services from them, contract values and competitor counts - an indirect read on the bank's own delivery footprint and, occasionally, on subcontracted technology.

source_name: JOSEPHINE (PROEBIZ) e-procurement / e-auction platform, Slovak instance
why_relevant: Slovak commercial e-sourcing platform used by both public and PRIVATE purchasers, including a Qualification System for managing qualified supplier groups and low-value purchases. This is the most plausible national-level venue where a Slovak bank or bank subsidiary would run an e-auction or invitation-only RFP outside ÚVO. Its public tender/profile listings can be mined for bank or bank-subsidiary buyer names.

source_name: ERANET e-procurement system (supplier portal + qualification + online bidding)
why_relevant: ERANET (integrated with PROEBIZ e-auctions) is the second Slovak e-sourcing stack, deployed as per-buyer instances (e.g. posta.eranet.sk) that expose public supplier-qualification listings. Relevant because bank-adjacent and group entities (e.g. Slovenská pošta, closely tied to 365.bank) publish qualification systems here that a bank vendor would need to enter.

source_name: Slovenská pošta – Verejné obstarávanie (proxy channel for the 365.bank / Poštová banka ecosystem)
why_relevant: 365.bank/Poštová banka distributes through Slovenská pošta branches and Slovenská pošta is a contracting authority. Post tenders for branch IT, cash handling, counter terminals and payment infrastructure are therefore a legitimate, fully public window onto procurement that would otherwise be invisible inside the private bank.

source_name: 365.bank – group structure page (Skupina 365.bank)
why_relevant: Names the group entities (Poštová banka, 365.invest, 365.fintech, Ahoj, PB Finančné služby, SKPAY, PB Servis, Cards) - SKPAY and Cards in particular are payments/card-processing entities whose own vendor relationships and contracts are separately traceable. Essential actor map for the bypass route, since procurement may sit in a service subsidiary (PB Servis) rather than the bank.

source_name: VÚB banka – Etický kódex (supplier-binding code of conduct)
why_relevant: The code explicitly binds SUPPLIERS as well as employees, so it carries the compliance preconditions a vendor must accept before entering a VÚB obstarávacia súťaž. Useful for understanding qualification barriers (ESG, anti-corruption, Legislative Decree 231/2001 lineage from Intesa).

source_name: Tatra banka corporate site – supplier/procurement discovery entry point
why_relevant: Searches for a Tatra banka supplier portal returned only MERCHANT-side portals (Obchodnícky portál, splátkový portál) - a documented naming collision. The corporate site remains the entry point for any future 'pre dodávateľov' page; its /files/sk/ PDF tree is indexable and is where procurement conditions would most likely be published.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank International – group site (parent sourcing for Tatra banka)
why_relevant: Tatra banka is an RBI subsidiary; where no SK supplier page exists, RBI group procurement/vendor policy and any group e-sourcing tool is the upstream channel. Also confirms the legal-entity mapping needed for contract and registry lookups.

source_name: Prvá stavebná sporiteľňa (PSS) – bank profile / statutory information
why_relevant: PSS shareholder structure (Bausparkasse Schwäbisch Hall, Raiffeisen Bausparkassen Managementservice, Slovak state ~10%) determines whether sourcing is German/Austrian group-led. No supplier page found; this profile page is the entry point and the ownership fact drives which group portal to watch.

source_name: Prima banka Slovensko – corporate site (procurement discovery entry point)
why_relevant: Prima banka is present in every Slovak district (largest branch estate relative to size) making its branch-IT and self-service device sourcing commercially significant. No public supplier page found; the site's preview-file PDF tree is the practical crawl target.

source_name: UniCredit Group corporate portal domain (supplier-side lead)
why_relevant: UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia sources via UniCredit group procurement. The group's portal domain is the only concrete endpoint located this run; the actual supplier/fornitori registration URL was NOT found and remains an open lead rather than a confirmed source.

source_name: FinStat – Slovak company financials & entity registry (bank + subsidiary entity resolution)
why_relevant: Provides IČO, legal successor names (e.g. 365.bank, a.s., historically Poštová banka, a.s.), financials and related-entity links. Necessary to resolve which legal entity signs vendor contracts, and to query CRZ/ÚVO/RPVS by exact IČO rather than brand name.

source_name: banky.sk – Slovak bank directory (actor map for the full SK banking population)
why_relevant: Enumerates all licensed banks and branches of foreign banks operating in SK, including entities easy to miss in this cell (Prima banka, PSS, Poštová banka odštepný závod 365.banky). Useful to make sure the supplier-page sweep covers the whole population and not just the top five.

source_name: PROEBIZ (NAR marketing / proebiz.com) – vendor site & client base
why_relevant: Operator of JOSEPHINE and the PROebiz e-auction engine. Vendor pages, references and per-client subdomains (e.g. tsk.proebiz.com, zscargo.proebiz.com) enumerate which Slovak organisations run competitions off-portal — a map of buyers to monitor.

source_name: BASE PROEBIZ (supplier/market base)
why_relevant: PROEBIZ's supplier-side database; useful for identifying which vendors compete in Slovak sourcing events and for reverse-mapping buyer categories.

source_name: ERANET – systém riadenia obstarávaní (innovis, s.r.o.)
why_relevant: Operator page lists 1,000+ M EUR procurement volume and named clients including Allianz (private financial-sector buyer), Slovenská pošta, ŽSR, Slovenské elektrárne, VSE, SEPS. The footer enumerates per-client subdomain instances — the fastest route to a buyer registry of semi-private/private ERANET users invisible in state systems.

source_name: ERANET instance – Slovenská pošta (posta.eranet.sk)
why_relevant: Slovenská pošta is a payments-relevant buyer (postal financial services, cash handling, counter terminals) and runs its sourcing through its own ERANET instance rather than only the state portal.

source_name: ERANET instance – Slovenské elektrárne (obstaravanie.seas.sk / seas.eranet.sk)
why_relevant: Model of a large semi-private buyer publishing its own tender index off the state system; template for how utility/corporate instances expose data, and relevant for cross-sector IT/payments sourcing.

source_name: eZakazky – elektronické verejné obstarávanie (eBIZ)
why_relevant: Multi-tenant e-procurement platform with a cross-buyer published-tender search (filters: CPV, NUTS, value, dates, contract type). Hosts per-buyer sub-portals (e.g. /siea/, /frsr/ Finančné riaditeľstvo SR) — a queryable index of contracts including financial-administration IT.
